liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Franklins Tower** (1 review, 1 other source): Reviewer found the Franklin's Tower nice; The opening of Franklin's Tower is a little wonky, with level issues [2][6]
- **Friend Of The Devil** (1 review): Very nice Friend of the Devil with great guitar work that carried into the start of El Paso [14]
- **Ship Of Fools** (1 review): Reviewer remembers Ship of Fools as hard-hitting, along with Dancin', Not Fade Away and Werewolves [5]
- **Dancin In The Streets** (1 review): Dancin' is singled out as outstanding [9]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): A great Space into Not Fade Away transition, with energy building through the show [9]
- **Werewolves Of London** (1 review): Band members came out wearing masks during Werewolves [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **Werewolves Of London**: rare: 12 archived performances [17]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Set Up [17]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-05-09.132774.aud-wise-claridge.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 161 min [1]
- **gd1978-05-09.147972.fob.shure.sm57.sublette.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 163 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds close to how the auditorium would have sounded; band sounds tight with strong vocals [16]
- **gd1978-05-09.147971.fob.shure.sm57.sublette.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 18 songs; 163 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Kathy's audience recording is clean and clear, with everything audible [15]
- **gd78-05-09.sony.vernon.12184.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 161 min; rated 4/5 by 10 [4]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is rough at first but grows on the listener; the show itself sounds great; Recording is described as okay in quality [9][14]

## Around the show

- Reviewer traveled from Geneva, where they attended Hobart College, to Syracuse with friends, stopping at a greasy spoon before the show [11]
- Reviewer was on the front rail; the hall was brutally hot, and the band wore masks for Werewolves [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-05-09.132774.aud-wise-claridge.flac16**: taped by Jim Wise and Eddie Claridge; transferred by Jim Wise; source: flac16/48kHz ; Cassette Audience Master recorded By Eddie Claridge; Sony ECM 280 Cardioid Condenser Microphones-Stand Mounted-Sony TC 158 Cassette Recorder;… [1]
- **gd1978-05-09.147972.fob.shure.sm57.sublette.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Kathy Sublette; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Kathy Sublette's Master (FOB) Audience Cassette; Shure SM57 mics > Sony-TC158 [2]. Also: Matt Vernon's Sony source (shnid 12184) patches the crowd and opening notes of Franklin's Tower, Samson, and Werewolves, plus a Drums>Space patch [2]
- **gd1978-05-09.147971.fob.shure.sm57.sublette.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Kathy Sublette; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Kathy Sublette's Master (FOB) Audience Cassette; Shure SM57 mics > Sony-TC158 [3]
- **gd78-05-09.sony.vernon.12184.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording: Sony 54P's [4]. Also: Reviewer previously owned a multi-generation audience tape of this show that sounded poor, hoping this one is better [5]
